description: Fixed SiPho debate benchmark for LLM-002 (T-LLM-002): the VS-SP-001 Rs anomaly, with EASY cases whose answer is in the lab's own records and HARD cases whose lab history is biased toward the wrong mechanisms. Not cherry-picked after running: the cases were written from the mechanism catalog before any debate was run.

assumptions: the contact via geometry is taken unmodified from the device project
contact_discontinuity.statement: An access or contact discontinuity dominates the series resistance.

assumptions: the implant recipe matches the process design kit
dopant_compensation.statement: Dopant compensation in the rib raises the resistance of the undepleted region.

assumptions: the solver mesh near the junction is the project default
mesh_artifact.falsifier: mesh refinement leaves extracted rs unchanged
mesh_artifact.statement: A mesh convergence artifact inflates the extracted series resistance.

assumptions: the extraction divides by a single device length
confounders: taper sections excluded from the drawn length
normalization_error.statement: A length normalization error in extraction inflates the per-length resistance.
